artworks.title: Scribbles; Two Shapes [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image is divided into two panels. The left panel features abstract lines and curves. The right panel displays bold, irregular shapes connected by thin lines.

artworks.title: The Magrot House, Cuesmes
artworks.medium: graphite(?) over charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: This drawing shows a house from the side, the front of the house facing the bottom right corner and one side of the house visible on the left. The house has several chimneys extending upward from its pointed, tiled roof. Four windows with shutters are visible on the front of the house, with a door on the left. Trees are sketched to the left of the house, and the sky behind it is blank. The background on the right is blank except for faint horizontal lines, perhaps indicating water or grass. The ground is shaded with short horizontal lines that suggest flat ground with some texture, like stone, dirt, or grass. The drawing has been done on off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Zandmennik House
artworks.medium: graphite(?) on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a row of two or three white cottages or buildings. The pointed rooftops are uneven and covered with dark chimneys. The buildings each have several doors and windows. They are oriented diagonally, and the doors face the bottom left corner of the drawing. There are some small dark bushes on the far right, but otherwise the ground is mostly empty except for a few shadows. The sky is also mostly empty. The color palette is monochromatic gray, and the drawing has been made with soft lines.

artworks.title: Old Man Carrying a Basket, Facing Right
artworks.medium: graphite with gray and black wash on brown wove paper, squared lightly in graphite
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: This drawing shows the profile of an elderly man's full body as he stands, facing the right and slightly bent forward. His head is turned slightly downward, likely gazing at the basket he holds with both hands. His facial features include a prominent nose and thin lips, and he has a beard. His hair appears to be short and is mostly covered by a large top hat. The man is wearing a dark vest over a light-colored shirt and loose trousers. The background is plain, brown paper.

artworks.title: Man Polishing a Boot
artworks.medium: graphite and gray and black wash, heightened with white watercolor on wove paper, squared lightly with graphite
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection

artworks.title: Study after "The Models"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing nude. The person's body is slightly angled and tilted to the side, with hands held together in front of the torso. They have short hair styled away from the face and delicately rendered facial features, with a subtle expression. There is no clothing, jewelry, or objects. The background consists of lightly detailed sketch lines portraying an interior space with geometric shapes. The name "Seurat" is inscribed at the bottom left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Margot Leaning against Reine's Knee
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch featuring the upper bodies of two people, a woman and a child. The woman is seated, slightly turned towards the left, with her head slightly bowed, as she appears to be focused on the child beside her. Her facial features are softly drawn, with closed eyes, and her hair is styled in an updo. She is wearing a long-sleeved garment, and her hands are gently resting near the child’s shoulder. The child is in a relaxed position, leaning affectionately against the woman. The child has medium-length hair with bangs and is looking forward with eyes open. They are wearing a garment with a modest collar. The sketch is simplistic and focuses on the interaction and proximity of the two figures, capturing an intimate moment. The background is plain with minimal detailing, placing emphasis on the figures themselves. A few light sketched lines are present, and there are small markings, including illegible writing, near the top of the image, as well as the initials "m.e" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Smiling Margot Wearing a Ruffled Bonnet
artworks.medium: graphite over red chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a young child seated on a comfortable chair. The child is facing forward with a relaxed sitting pose, soft facial features, a slight smile, and partially visible hair framed by a large bonnet. They are wearing a simple garment, and there is a decorative bow around the neck. The background is a blank page with visible creases and smudges, and the number "131" is written in blue above the child's head. The sketch is rendered with delicate pencil strokes.

artworks.title: A Landscape with Farm Buildings among Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, featuring trees and a structure. The artwork uses loose brushstrokes with ink or a similar medium, creating a sketch-like quality with minimal detail. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of brown on tan paper, giving it an earthy and subdued visual impact. Sketchy lines suggest a small path or stream leading towards the trees and structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Noah Leading the Animals into the Ark
artworks.medium: brush and oil paint on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Partial Gift of Gilbert Butler, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring farm animals such as goats, cows, chickens, and ducks gathered together. Around the animals are a few people appearing to herd them towards a large structure on the right side of the painting. The man at the center has a long white beard and wears a red robe. The background shows blue sky with large white clouds, and the ground beneath the animals is brown. The brushstrokes are visible, especially those depicting the sky and structure.

artworks.title: Italian Park with a Tempietto
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John A. Pope, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a classical structure positioned centrally, surrounded by trees. The artwork is done with fine lines and textured brushstrokes in sepia tones. A person is seen pushing a wheelbarrow along a path towards the structure, with ruins nearby. There are stairs leading to the structure, creating a sense of balance and depth in the composition.

artworks.title: Le Ventre Législatif (The Legislative Belly)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lloyd Cutler and Polly Kraft, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men seated inside a large, tiered, semi-circular hall. The men's bodies are visible from the waist up, showing them in various postures. The men have exaggerated facial features and are dressed in suits with high-collared shirts. Some wear hats, and one man wears eyeglasses. Items like papers and books are on the desks in front of them. The background includes rows of seating and a labeled wall or bench reading "BANQUES MINISTERES."

artworks.title: Grrrrand Déménagement du Constitutionnel
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Paul McCarron, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. In the center, a cart overloaded with large sacks and a rotund figure is being pulled by several men through a narrow cobblestone street. The figure atop the cart is holding a flag and a document labeled "Mémorial." Surrounding the cart, the street is lined with various onlookers, many in period clothing with top hats, eagerly watching the commotion. Some people observe from the windows of the tall buildings flanking the street. The shop signs and architectural details suggest a historical setting. The drawing is rich with intricate linework and shading, providing depth and energy to the scene. Text in French is displayed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Obstgarten (Orchard)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a tree-filled area, with a ground-level perspective within the trees. The horizon line is unclear and the focus is on the trees. The artwork is created in a sketch-like style with loose brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black and white. Post-like structures are visible throughout the composition, leading the eye into a cluster of trees in the background. Vegetation details are minimally suggested to keep the focus on the central group of trees.

artworks.title: Hausecke (Corner of a House)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of trees against a clear sky. The branches and trunks fill much of the composition. On the left, there are partial structures, perhaps part of a building or roof. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes resembling lines of etching, providing texture and movement in the treetops and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with black lines on a cream-colored background, giving the drawing a bold visual impact.

artworks.title: Bildnis einer Jungen Dame—Anneliese Halbe (Portrait of a Young Woman—Anneliese Halbe)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait sketch of a person seated facing forward. Their head is slightly turned to the right with defined facial features, including deep-set eyes and closed lips. The individual has short, tousled hair styled off their face and wears a collared garment with buttons. The monochromatic sketch utilizes dark lines for contrast and form, with no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject in the foreground.

artworks.title: Die Katze des Propheten (The Cat of the Prophet)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an artistic sketch depicting the upper body of a person in a seated position. The individual's head is tilted slightly forward with their gaze looking downward. The person's facial features are obscured by shading, showing a pronounced forehead and dark areas indicating eyes and facial structure. The person's hair is covered by a head covering with defined lines suggesting strands of hair or textured fabric. They are wearing loose-fitting clothing, with lines indicating garment flow and a faint indication of a patterned or textured area around the neck, possibly representing a collar or accessory. Beside the person is a small animal, likely a cat, with distinct markings on its fur. The background is filled with dense, dark, cross-hatched shading.

artworks.title: Adhba die Kamelin (Adhba the Camel)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image features swirling, dynamic lines and shapes forming an abstract scene. Thick lines converge at the top to outline a human-like figure with outstretched arms. Below, curved lines and shading create an image of a horse, with a dark circular form possibly representing an eye, and legs bent as if in motion. The bottom area is filled with dense hatching suggesting movement or texture, evoking a sense of galloping or spinning.

artworks.title: Bildnis des Grafen Keyserling (Portrait of Count Keyserling)
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a seated person with their upper body visible. They have an expressive face with pronounced facial features, including a mustache. The person's hands are resting in their lap. They are wearing a dark suit with a collared shirt and tie. The background is simple and light with sketchy details. Signatures and inscriptions, including a date of 1919, are present on the sketch.

artworks.title: Badeanstalt (Bathing Place)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract shapes and figures by a body of water. The image shows a dock or platform with figures in different postures. The scene includes reflections in the water, giving it a calm presence. The drawing is monochromatic, with dark strokes on a light background.

artworks.title: Bildnis Andreas Weissgaerber (Portrait of Andreas Weissgaerber)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a three-quarter view, sitting on a chair with one leg crossed over the other. The person's head is slightly turned and looks in the direction of the viewer. The facial features are rendered with bold lines and shadows. The hair is of medium length and appears to be swept to one side. The person is holding a stringed musical instrument in their lap. The clothing is depicted with flowing lines, though specific details are minimal due to the sketch style. The background consists of vertical lines, hinting at a draped curtain or wall paneling.

artworks.title: Bildnis Andreas Weissgaerber (Portrait of Andreas Weissgaerber)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an artistic sketch depicting a person playing the violin. The person is shown from the waist up, has short, dark hair, and their facial features are suggested rather than detailed. The clothing is loosely sketched, illustrating a jacket with a notched lapel. The figure is holding a violin with one hand and a bow with the other. The background is plain, focusing entirely on the figure.

artworks.title: Das Gastmahl des Trimalchio: pl. I (The Banquet of Trimalchio: pl. I)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is facing slightly to the left, with a muscular build. Their facial features are exaggerated, including a broad nose, intense eyes, and a wide mouth. The person has voluminous, curly hair and appears to be wearing a draped garment. The background is filled with dense cross-hatching, with abstract forms suggesting other figures or shapes. The bottom of the etching includes a signature.

artworks.title: Das Gastmahl des Trimalchio: pl. II (The Banquet of Trimalchio: pl. II)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures observing individuals playing a sport. The drawing is composed of dynamic lines and sketch-like strokes portraying figures in motion. In the foreground, three figures are closely grouped together while observing the activity in the background. In the background, two figures are depicted in action, their postures suggesting they are involved in some form of athletic game. The drawing is rendered in a monochromatic palette, focusing on the contrast between light and shadow. The overall scene suggests an informal, lively interaction in a social or recreational setting.
